newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea bank says to consider fresh loans to Jinro.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea bank says to consider fresh loans to Jinro.

text.p: South Korea's Commercial Bank of Korea would consider providing fresh loans to the stricken Jinro Group if the conglomerate presented an acceptable restructuring plan, a bank official said on Tuesday.
The official would not provide any other details.

The domestic media earlier reported Jinro, which is experiencing financial difficulties after expanding into distribution, beer and construction, asked the bank, its prime creditor, to extend 200 billion won in rescue loans.
The group said it planned to sell off unprofitable businesses, including its canned food and soft drink lines, real estate and other assets, to improve its financial status.
